oneri: Niani'nin 14. yy Mali baskenti oldugu iki akademik kaynakta teyitli: atlas s: mali-imparatorlugu 1281-01-01..1670-01-01 KALSIN. Ek beyan: 'baskent kimligi 14. yy icin al-Umari (Nyeni) + Ibn Battuta 1353 + Filipowiak kazisi (1968-) ile teyitli; 13. yy (Sundiata) baskent iddiasi sozlu gelenege dayanir, Hunwick 'alleged'; 1599 Jenne yenilgisinden sonra Mali ~25 yil icinde parcalandi (UNESCO GHA IV); atlasin t=1670 ucu bu kaynakla dogrulanmadi (TDV'de de yok), akademik gelenek, teyitsiz'. Niani s: degistirilmesin; 1599-1670 araligina BEYANLI YAKLASIKLIK notu eklenmesi onerilir (kunye t'sine dokunmadan).
kaynak: (1) UNESCO General History of Africa IV, ed. D.T. Niane (1984), archive.org unesco_general_history_africa_iv djvu txt, hepsi includes=true: «The town of Niani is in Camara territory, on the Sankarani» · «The region of Mali is where the king’s residence is located in the town of Nyeni» (al-Umari) · «Ibn Battiita, who visited the town in 1353, called it ‘Malli’» · «The town became the political and economic capital of the empire» · «The capital, Niani, had at least 100000 inhabitants in the four- teenth century» · «Mali was eventually dismembered in the next twenty-five years» (1599 sonrasi) · «Mansa Mamudu was finally defeated in front of Jenne». (2) Britannica 'Niani' (Britannica Editors), tarayicida birebir: «Niani remained the capital of the Muslim Mandingo empire for 300 years; it reached its zenith as Mali’s political, commercial, and caravan centre» ve «The site of the medieval Malian capital was not confirmed until excavations were made in the mid-1960s». UYARI: Britannica ve Niane ayni gelenege (Delafosse/Filipowiak) yaslaniyor, tam bagimsiz degil; Levtzion Ancient Ghana and Mali (archive.org bwb_S0-AWH-349, odunc) okunamadi.
kunye_kontrol: mali-imparatorlugu f 1235-01-01 (Kirina, TDV mali) t 1670-01-01 (TDV'de yok, beyanli); baskent: Niani. Niani s: 1281-01-01..1670-01-01 kunye omru icinde; sinir ihlali yok.
not: Celiski degil, nitelik farki: 14. yy baskent teyitli (Arap tanik + kazi); 13. yy baskent = sozlu gelenek; 1625-1670 ucu zayif. Gercekten bagimsiz ikinci kaynak icin Levtzion 1973 veya Hunwick (Sa'di, 1599 sonrasi Mali) bu turda erisilemedi.
